craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of fitted joinery — utsāha as qualifier meets qualified without loss. pot-cloth kept verbatim — example IS the proof (one words laying-over); oneness end-weight. Rejected: (a) modernizing example → killed: vighna + the stock example carries śāstra-memory. (b) explaining adhyāropa → killed: row 10. Read aloud: HELD in ONE re-FLEC-tion, BY-one-WORD's LAY-ing-OV-er — … POT-cloth.

lines: Held in one reflection, by one word's laying-over —
the many still would reach oneness — 'pot-cloth'.

reads_against.argmap: How do the many reach unity? → Many reach oneness through one-word superimposition — 'pot-cloth'.
c1_essence: Unity without strain for the consciousness-bodied; the worldly one's reflection-object fixed as difference-pithed non-difference-shining (vv10-11).
Mechanics: one thought un-touched, one word uniting many, helping relation admitted, twoness in manyness, two facings, three thinkings, genitive settling unself-lost (vv12-18).
